title: GPT-6.1 Sol helps construct a compact non-Kähler Ricci soliton
summary: The authors construct a gradient shrinking Ricci soliton on a simply connected eight-dimensional flag manifold and show that its metric is nowhere locally Kähler.

evidence.tested: The authors report checking the proof and replaying the supplied computational verification successfully.
evidence.unknown: The computational replay is from the study team. Independent reproduction was not established.
evidence.ai_role: The authors say GPT-6.1 Sol initially generated the construction, proof arguments and verification code in response to their prompt.
